sections.heading: Company profile
sections.body:
Capital Wraps is an industry leading large format graphics application and vehicle wrap company providing nationally recognized designs, high-resolution photographic printing and professional installation.

Industry: Advertising & Marketing · HQ: Raleigh, North Carolina · Size: 50-249 · Products: Vehicle Wraps, Fleet Wraps, Corporate Signage, Wall Graphics, Event Graphics, Elevator Wraps

sections.heading: Qualification summary
sections.body: Capital Wraps scores 64 of 100 (tier B) at 90% confidence. The score is carried by industry fit (28/30), application fit (25/25) and company size (6/15). Nothing was found for event engagement, so those score zero rather than being estimated.

sections.heading: Tedlar angle
sections.body: They already market on lifespan, which means the durability conversation is a product discussion rather than an education. Relevant Tedlar positioning: Tedlar overlaminates let printers underwrite longer graphic warranties.

sections.heading: Comparable accounts
sections.body: Closest known-good accounts: Avery Dennison Graphics Solutions (34% similar on vehicle, graphics, wrap, fleet); Mactac (24% similar on vehicle, signage, graphics, wraps); Drytac (13% similar on graphics, print, wall, protective). Reference the comparable account by name on the call — a converter is far more persuaded by what a peer does than by a spec sheet.

sections.heading: Gaps and risks
sections.body:
• Event engagement: Confirming attendance at one more show would add points.
• Flags on the record: size third party estimate
